mark.not_kept: The papers for this one aren’t kept in this browser.
mark.not_kept_text: Open it once in the current app, or drop the download in there again, and it opens here too.
mark.page_bad: This page could not be read.
mark.later: Comes with the next part of the new marking screen.
mark.which_rubric_text: The assignment card and this download’s saved work have different rubrics, so their scores would come out differently.
mark.wrap_drag: Drag to set where the text wraps
mark.page_width_tip: Wrap at the edge of the page
mark.comment_ph: Type a comment… Enter to finish, Shift Enter for a new line
mark.save_reuse_tip: Keep this comment so you can reuse it
mark.bank_saved: Saved. It’ll show up under every new comment.
mark.cannot: Not saved: this window can’t save just now
mark.m_once_tip: Drag once, then back to your tool
mark.comment_for_ph: Comment for the student (optional). It shows on the Grades tab so you can copy it.
mark.key_score: Score the row in hand (a full stop for the half)
mark.every_row: Every row has a score. To change one, click the row first.
mark.no_half: There’s no half on this scale.
mark.g_help: Click any score or comment to copy it, then paste it into your gradebook. Click a name to open that paper.
mark.g_paper_tip: The grade written on the paper itself, read from the file
mark.i_no_spread: No finished scores yet, so there’s nothing to chart.
mark.i_rows_cap: Average out of each row’s top, lowest first.
mark.i_total_only: This assignment is scored with just a total, so there are no rows to compare.
mark.i_all_done: Everyone has a finished score or a mark saying why not.
mark.i_off_scale: Read from the paper, not on this scale
mark.i_own_off: Your score is above the total or below 0
mark.i_left_out: Left out of the average by you

mark.r_from.one: From {n} student, in their own folders, ready to hand back.
mark.r_from.other: From {n} students, in their own folders, ready to hand back.

mark.r_skipped.one: {n} student has nothing marked, so they’re left out.
mark.r_skipped.other: {n} students have nothing marked, so they’re left out.

mark.r_left.one: {n} file you left out isn’t in it.
mark.r_left.other: {n} files you left out aren’t in it.

mark.r_nothing: Nothing is marked yet. Mark a paper and it will show up here.
mark.r_all_early: Everyone with marked work got theirs early.

mark.r_early.one: Leave out the student who got theirs early
mark.r_early.other: Leave out the {n} students who got theirs early

mark.r_dir_no: This browser didn’t allow saving to a folder. Use Download ZIP.
mark.r_busy: The last export is still going. It will say when it’s done.
mark.r_once: Once the students have it, mark it as returned.
mark.r_one_hint: All their papers in one file, the feedback page first. Word papers become pages too. A Word rubric you scored still goes as a Word file.
mark.r_names: Name each file by student and assignment
mark.r_names_like: Like “{name}”. Graded when it has a score, Feedback when it doesn’t.
mark.r_names_off: Files keep the names they were turned in with.
mark.r_sheet: Add the grade sheet (a crop of each typed grade)
mark.r_edit_hint: Bring a file back in later and change its marks. Files are about twice as big.
mark.r_key: Add a key to the marks used on each paper
mark.r_fb: Put a feedback page in front of each paper
mark.r_fb_hint: The score, each rubric row with what its level means, your comment, and the comments on the paper with their page numbers.
mark.r_all: Also send back files with no marks (Word files, other files and unmarked pages)
mark.r_foot: Your original files don’t change. A file you marked anywhere goes back whole, every page in order. Comments go in a right-hand margin.
mark.r_one_text: Give one student their marked paper now, without waiting for the rest.
mark.r_one_none: Open a student’s paper on the Mark tab first.
mark.r_one_nothing: Nothing on {name}’s paper is marked yet. Mark it, then export.

mark.r_one_zip.one: Saved {n} file for this student in one ZIP.
mark.r_one_zip.other: Saved {n} files for this student in one ZIP.

mark.w_none: No assignments in this class yet.
mark.w_nothing: Nothing found in what you dropped
mark.w_failed: These papers couldn’t be brought in.
mark.w_drop: You can also drop a download, a ZIP or a folder on an assignment.
mark.wd_comment_tip: Select words, then press this to comment on them. Or pick the Comment tool and click a word.
mark.wd_cannot: This Word file couldn’t be opened here. Download it to open it in Word.
mark.wd_not_kept: This browser couldn’t keep your edit. Download the file to keep it.
mark.wd_bar: Click any text to type. Click a table cell, then a color to shade it:
mark.wd_macros_note: Macros can’t run in a browser, but they stay in the file, so they work again when you open it in Word.
mark.wd_box_tip: Click to highlight this score (two neighbouring boxes = half point)
mark.wd_each: Click a score box in each criterion
mark.wd_max_differs: This rubric is out of {a}, but Rubric setup is out of {b}, so the score panel won’t match it. To score from this rubric, choose Just the total in Rubric setup.
mark.wd_class_outof: This table adds up to {a}, but this assignment is out of {b}. Make the whole class out of {a}?
mark.wd_class_both: This table adds up to {a}, but this assignment is out of {b}. Make the whole class out of {a}, and use the grading scale in this file?
mark.wd_class_scale: This file prints its own grading scale, and it isn’t the one this assignment uses. Use it for the whole class?
mark.wd_table: A table in this file could be a score rubric.
mark.wd_no_comments: This Word file’s comments couldn’t be read, so a new one can’t be added here. Download it to comment in Word.
mark.wd_right_click: Right-click on a word to comment on it
mark.wd_select: Select the words to comment on, then press Comment. Or pick the Comment tool and click a word.
mark.wd_no_orig: The original isn’t kept in this browser
mark.wd_edit_first: Click Edit first to change the file
mark.op_all: Everything opened: {files} for {students}. Nothing looks odd.
mark.op_click: Click a name to go there.
mark.f_cant: This kind of file can’t be shown here. Download to open it.
mark.f_score: You can still give a score.
mark.f_removed_t: Removed {name}. It waits under Removed files, below the paper.

mark.f_removed_marks.one: Removed {name} and its mark. Both wait under Removed files, below the paper.
mark.f_removed_marks.other: Removed {name} and its {n} marks. They wait under Removed files, below the paper.

mark.f_rpl_text: The new file takes the old one’s place on the paper and in the export. The score stays as it is. The old file waits under Removed files, so you can bring it back.

mark.f_rpl_marks.one: The new file takes the old one’s place on the paper and in the export. The score stays as it is. Marks can’t move onto different pages, so the old file keeps its mark. It waits under Removed files, so you can bring it back.
mark.f_rpl_marks.other: The new file takes the old one’s place on the paper and in the export. The score stays as it is. Marks can’t move onto different pages, so the old file keeps its {n} marks. It waits under Removed files, so you can bring it back.

mark.f_not_kept: This browser couldn’t keep {name} for next time. It’s here until you close the download.
mark.f_move_text: The file goes to that student with your marks on it. If this student has a score or comment, you’ll be asked whether it goes too. Moving it back works the same way.

mark.f_mv_q.one: {a} has {said}. Move it to {b} with this file?
mark.f_mv_q.other: {a} has {said}. Move them to {b} with this file?

mark.f_mv_leave_it.one: Leave it if it’s about that one.
mark.f_mv_leave_it.other: Leave it if it’s about those.

mark.f_mv_leave_them.one: Leave them if they’re about that one.
mark.f_mv_leave_them.other: Leave them if they’re about those.

mark.f_mv_clash: {a} keeps {said}, because {b} already has their own. Nothing was written over. Change either one if it belongs with this file.
mark.f_left_t: Left out {name}. Bring back undoes it.
mark.wd_pdf_tip: Turn this file into pages you can mark and comment on anywhere, like a PDF. The Word file is kept.
mark.f_pdf_text: The Word file becomes pages you can mark, comment on and stamp anywhere, like any PDF. The Word file isn’t changed. It waits under Removed files at the bottom of the paper, with Bring back.
mark.f_pdf_edited: What you typed or shaded in this file shows on the pages. Comments are numbered, and listed after the last page.
mark.f_pdf_used: You took this student’s grade from what’s typed in this Word file. That stays with the Word file, so give the score in the score panel after converting.
mark.f_pdf_all: All {n} Word papers in this assignment

mark.f_pdf_kept.one: ({n} you’ve typed in, commented on or scored from stays a Word file)
mark.f_pdf_kept.other: ({n} you’ve typed in, commented on or scored from stay Word files)

mark.f_pdf_always: From now on, convert Word papers as each assignment opens

mark.f_pdf_done.one: This Word paper is now PDF pages
mark.f_pdf_done.other: {n} Word papers are now PDF pages

mark.f_pdf_not.one: {n} stays a Word file, because it’s longer than {max} pages or couldn’t be drawn.
mark.f_pdf_not.other: {n} stay Word files, because they’re longer than {max} pages or couldn’t be drawn.

mark.f_turn_l: Turn this page to the left
mark.f_turn_r: Turn this page to the right
mark.f_paste_text: For work a student sent in an email or a message. It becomes a page you can mark, score and export like any paper, added after their other files. It stays in this browser.
mark.f_paste_pic: Some letters can’t be typed into the page, so it comes in as a picture of the text. Pen, highlighter and comments still work.
mark.c_ask: “{name}”, which you’ve already worked on, may be an older copy of this download.
mark.c_ask_unchecked: The student and file names match, but the older papers aren’t kept here to compare.

mark.c_ask_same.one: {named} of {all} files have the same names, and {n} is exactly the same.
mark.c_ask_same.other: {named} of {all} files have the same names, and {n} are exactly the same.

mark.c_ask_q: Bring them over copies your marks and scores into this one. Start fresh leaves this one empty. The older copy stays either way.

mark.c_changed_toast.one: One file is different from the copy you opened before. Look for the ! in the list of students.
mark.c_changed_toast.other: {n} files are different from the copy you opened before. Look for the ! in the list of students.

mark.c_pill: New or changed since the older copy

mark.c_intro.one: This looks like a newer copy of {name}. Marks and scores for {n} student came over. The older copy hasn’t changed: it’s still on Home.
mark.c_intro.other: This looks like a newer copy of {name}. Marks and scores for {n} students came over. The older copy hasn’t changed: it’s still on Home.

mark.c_unchecked: The older papers aren’t kept in this browser, so which files changed couldn’t be checked. Have a look through them.
mark.c_l_changed: Changed, so check your marks still sit in the right places:
mark.c_l_lost: These have marks on pages they no longer have. The older copy still has them:
mark.c_l_status: Marked missing or excused, and has a new or changed file here. Check that still holds:
mark.c_l_gone: Not in this download (your work on them stays in the older copy):
mark.c_l_layouts: Pages back in their plain order, because these students’ files changed:
mark.c_l_edits: Word edits left in the older copy, because the file changed or isn’t in this download:
mark.c_failed: Some late files, readings or Word edits couldn’t be copied over. They’re still in the older copy.
mark.c_foot: Changed and new files are flagged at the top of the file and with ! in the list of students.

mark.c_late.one: Mark {n} student with new files late
mark.c_late.other: Mark {n} students with new files late

mark.c_tip_new: This file wasn’t in the older copy of this download.
mark.c_tip_changed: This file is different from the one in the older copy. Your marks came over: check they still sit in the right places.

mark.c_lost.one: A mark on page {pages} has no page in this file now. The older copy still has it.
mark.c_lost.other: Marks on pages {pages} have no page in this file now. The older copy still has them.

mark.c_marked_late: Marked late. Late, on the right, takes it off.
mark.w_again_files: A newer copy, as files or a ZIP…
mark.w_again_folder: A newer copy, as a folder…
mark.a_open_tip: Combine files, reorder or take pages out
mark.a_start_tip: Move the picked pages to the start of their file
mark.a_earlier_tip: Move the picked pages one place earlier (← key)
mark.a_later_tip: Move the picked pages one place later (→ key)
mark.a_end_tip: Move the picked pages to the end of their file
mark.a_out_tip: Take the picked pages out (Delete key)
mark.a_turn_tip: Turn the picked pages a quarter turn to the right (R key)
mark.a_order_text: Word and other files sit among the page files in this order.
mark.a_order_all: Use this order for every student
mark.a_hint: Click a page to pick it, Shift-click to pick a run, {mod}-click to add one. Drag the picked pages, or use the buttons or the arrow keys. Double-click a page to see it big.
mark.a_name_hidden: File names can’t be changed while names are hidden
mark.a_del_file: Remove this file (pages go to the tray)
mark.a_tray_empty: Pages you take out land here.
mark.a_reset: Back to how it was turned in
mark.a_take_tip: Take this page out. It waits below the paper, with Bring back.

mark.i_has.one: This paper has {n} mark from another app. You can see it but not change it.
mark.i_has.other: This paper has {n} marks from another app. You can see them but not change them.

mark.i_others: {n} papers in this download have marks like these.

mark.i_now.one: {n} mark is now yours to change.
mark.i_now.other: {n} marks are now yours to change.

mark.i_kept.one: {n} mark (like a stamp or a picture) couldn’t be changed and stays on the page as it was.
mark.i_kept.other: {n} marks (like a stamp or a picture) couldn’t be changed and stay on the page as they were.

mark.i_flat: This file was exported from Grading Studio with its marks drawn into the page, so they can’t be changed here.
mark.i_flat_how: To change them, open the download you marked them in: your marks are kept there. Files exported with Keep marks editable on come back with their marks.
mark.i_locked: This file is locked, so its marks stay as they are.
mark.i_none: None of these marks could be made editable, so they stay as they are.
mark.i_failed: That didn’t work on this file. Its marks are as they were.

mark.i_sum.one: {n} paper has {marks} made in another app.
mark.i_sum.other: {n} papers have {marks} made in another app.

mark.i_sum_none: No paper in this download has marks from another app that could be made editable.
mark.i_auto: Do this by itself for papers I open from now on
mark.i_hint: Your original files aren’t changed, and Put back above each paper undoes it. A grade written in one of these comments still counts.
mark.l_no_scan: No scanned page to fix here
mark.l_pages_text: Click ☀ in a page’s corner to turn lighting off just there. Shift-click another page’s ☀ to do every page in between. ▾ sets lighting for that page alone, and does the rest of a file, a whole file, or the same page on every paper.
mark.l_offs: Turned off by you: {here} on this paper, {n} in all.
mark.l_owns: Own lighting: {here} on this paper, {n} in all.
mark.l_owns_same: Make them all the same as the rest
mark.l_exp_on: Exported files come out with this lighting. The student’s original file isn’t changed.
mark.l_exp_off: Only changes how you see the paper here; the export stays as scanned.
mark.l_chip_tip: Turn lighting off or on for this page. Shift-click another page’s ☀ to do every page in between.
mark.l_own_tip: This page has its own lighting (▾ to change it).
mark.l_more_tip: More: the rest of the file, the whole file, or the same page on every paper
mark.l_and_rest: This page and the rest of this file

mark.l_copied_rest.one: This page’s lighting on {n} more page
mark.l_copied_rest.other: This page’s lighting on {n} more pages

mark.l_copied_every.one: This page’s lighting on page {page} of {n} paper
mark.l_copied_every.other: This page’s lighting on page {page} of {n} papers
